kind: Bounded pressure-offload feasibility preflight; no GPU CFD speedup measured
recommendation: Keep the current circle pilots and CPU cases running unchanged. Do not start a full GPU dependency build for the current pilot deadline: no tested drop-in Foundation14/serial adapter was found.
viable_engineering_path: An isolated, pinned OGL/Ginkgo Foundation14 port is the best candidate reviewed; it requires API fixes, an MPI execution path or a real serial-initialization port, a CUDA13 ARM64 toolchain, a library build and an execution-owned equivalence/throughput benchmark before adoption.

candidates.name: OGL/Ginkgo
candidates.result: Best investigated port candidate, not currently build/run compatible without changes
evidence: README advertises Foundation6+; current checked-in CI matrix lists only ESIv2512.
Actual Foundation14 compile-only API subset fails for thisDb() and nbrPatchID(). Substitutions db() and nbrPatch().index() pass that subset only; full adapter not compiled.
Current DeviceIdHandler aborts when Pstream::parRun() is false, incompatible with the current plain serial foamRun runner.
CMake defaults force GPU-aware MPI, but installed MPI reports no CUDA-buffer support; an isolated build must disable that assumption/use host buffers or provide validated CUDA-aware MPI.
CUDA target links cudart,cublas,cusparse,curand,cufft,NVTX. Toolkit/compiler/libraries and CMake are absent locally.
Farfield-only scalar pressure matrices fit documented boundary/block limitations; CPU assembly, source terms and non-offloaded work remain.

candidates.name: petsc4foam
evidence: Its primary README explicitly requires OpenFOAM-v1912+ or recent OpenFOAM.com master, plus PETSc3.23+; no tested Foundation14 claim.
Needs a separate adapter port and CUDA-enabled PETSc dependency build; neither is installed.

candidates.name: community amgx4foam + NVIDIA AmgX
evidence: Inspected Make/options requires external foam2csr and hard-codes a CUDA11.6 include directory.
Wrapper source uses removed mesh().thisDb() and unconditionally includes cyclicAMILduInterface.H, absent from the installed Foundation14 source.
NVIDIA AmgX itself being GPU-capable does not establish compatibility of this separate wrapper.

actual_build_activity: Only g++ -fsyntax-only API subset checks, one CPU at a time; no shared-library or CUDA build

isolated_build_constraints.install_note: OGL installs to $FOAM_USER_LIBBIN explicitly. Override that variable to a private lib directory for the build/install subprocess; CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX alone does not isolate its install destination. Never modify the global shell/OpenFOAM environment.

timing_context.source: Execution agent existing log/progress estimates; not measured GPU timings
timing_context.observation: Typical existing logs show pressure GAMG about15–16 iterations and fewer momentum iterations, but this does not establish a pressure CPU percentage.

net_time.qualification: Single-GPU contention across concurrent cases and CPU matrix assembly must be measured; pressure-kernel timing alone is insufficient.
net_time.current_deadline: No evidence the port/toolchain/build/validation can amortize within the priority pilot45–90minute window.

bounded_next_step: If pursuing reuse beyond the current pilots: a30–45minute isolated Foundation14 header/translation-unit port spike using pinned OGL and Ginkgo plus private ARM64 CMake, with at most2build CPUs. Stop on broad API changes; install nothing globally.
Only after that passes, fetch checksum-verified CUDA13 linux-sbsa components into the isolated prefix, set architecture121 explicitly, disable unverified GPU-aware MPI, and build at most2CPUs.

Execution agent alone should then run one short isolated pressure-offload clone, matching mesh, initial0.6U,p, physics and CPU validation checks; compare end-to-end elapsed time and aggregate throughput before any production change.
